name: Bronte O'Connell
bio:
Bronte grew up around motorsport, her father a pit crew member for V8 Supercars. She started volunteering at race events as a teenager, quickly realizing her organizational skills were ideally suited for logistics. After earning a degree in supply chain management, she worked her way up through smaller racing teams, handling everything from transportation to pit stop equipment. She's known for her meticulous planning and ability to anticipate potential problems before they arise.

Bronte's approach to logistics is all about efficiency and reliability. She believes in clear communication and well-defined processes. She's not afraid to challenge the status quo, always looking for ways to streamline operations and reduce costs. What sets her apart is her deep understanding of the practical challenges faced by race teams on the ground, allowing her to create logistical solutions that are not only cost-effective but also highly effective in real-world racing conditions. She is excited to be working with Hendrick Motorsports.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Bronte is of average height, with a lean build and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool on her keychain.
Insists on color-coding all spreadsheets and documents.
Has a habit of pacing while on phone calls, even in confined spaces.
